snippet.title: Cat Crisis Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Cat Crisis is an online co-op game about being cute little cats rescuing even cuter kittens. Hide from terrifying dogs, pet frightened kittens, and rescue them to save all catkind! Play Cat Crisis with up to 4 players! (actually you can play with more)

OUT on Wednesday, August 5th on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4743970/Cat_Crisis/
